name: BKY Welded Plate Heat Exchanger
full_description: The official BKY product page describes this model as a patented welded plate heat exchanger product from Juyuan Hanyang. It uses a plate-frame style welded structure, combines advanced international heat transfer technology, and is intended for compact, high-efficiency heat transfer service under demanding media conditions.
advantage: High heat transfer coefficient and low resistance loss.
Strong adaptability to working conditions and flexible process combinations.
Better cleanability than brazed plate heat exchangers.
Strong temperature and pressure resistance for special media.

technical_parameters.Plate Material: TP304, TP316L, TP304L, TP317L, 254SMO, Titanium, N6, S31803 (SAF2205), 904L

seo_data.meta_description: Patented BKY welded plate heat exchanger with compact structure, strong cleanability, and flexible process configuration.
